يحتفروا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِرُوا (yaḥtafirū) /jaħ.ta.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# يُحْتَفَرُوا (yuḥtafarū) /juħ.ta.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
